summary: Lead accepted the native allocation ledger, fresh review scheduling adapter, and read-only contract audit; the audit found no unresolved API mismatch after host normalization.
source_report: E6 coordination author result: created an external acceptance ledger from all six actual probe.start acknowledgments and the captured nativeRebalancer 1.0.4 allocation; added an adapter that records implementation/review decisions outside the legacy extraction-only finish schema, prepares a fresh independent six-packet review spec from accepted receipts, invokes the pinned native probe, verifies unique eligible assignments, author exclusions, capacity, zero broken constraints, and the exact score, and records actual reviewer starts. Added the protocol and a read-only audit of the Go/WASM, host, DOM, and React boundaries. No production files were edited for E6. The E6 review solve is a separate post-acceptance coordination step.
